title: General Information — National Treasure Matsumoto Castle

facts.fact: The current operator distinguishes timed-entry electronic tickets from on-site paper tickets.
The Great Keep has six stories with steep narrow stairs and no elevator; shoes must be removed inside.
facts.excerpt: The Great Keep is a six-story building with steep, narrow stairs and no elevator.

facts.fact: Access is through Kuromon Gate; the red Uzumibashi Bridge is closed as an entrance.
facts.excerpt: Visitors must enter the grounds through the Kuromon Gate in front.

facts.fact: The operator warns that admission limits can create queues and restrict some garden areas during crowded periods.
facts.excerpt: limits may be placed on the number of people allowed inside the castle at a single time.

facts.fact: Combination tickets are sold online; the castle and other facilities have distinct access arrangements.
facts.excerpt: Combined tickets are only available online.

notes: Official page actually fetched and the named passages read; raw response and extracted text retained outside Git. Route choices and priorities are original editorial advice. No personal visit, demand ranking, guaranteed mountain view, price or timetable is claimed.
